recipe.title: Egg Bhurji

steps.text: Chop onions finely (prep implied by ingredient line).
steps.label: Chop onions

steps.text: Heat oil and butter in a moderately hot pan, add the chopped onions and allow the onions to sweat a little.
steps.label: Sweat onions

steps.text: Chop the green chillies and ginger (roughly/snipped) and add them to the pan with the onions; mix and sauté briefly.
steps.label: Add chilies & ginger

steps.text: Chop the tomatoes. Add the tomatoes to the pan and continue sautéing until they become nice and pulpy; sprinkle a little salt to aid the process.
steps.label: Cook tomatoes
steps.doneness_cue: till it becomes nice and pulpy

steps.text: Add turmeric, red chilli powder and pav bhaji masala to the tomato mixture and mix so the masala starts cooking.
steps.label: Add spices

steps.text: Lower the flame and cook the masalas nicely for 5 to 7 Minutes so the spices cook into the mixture.
steps.label: Cook masalas
steps.attention_cue: cook the masalas need to cook nicely for 5 to 7 Minutes
steps.doneness_cue: cook the masalas need to cook nicely

steps.text: Break the eggs into a bowl, add a little salt and whisk them; beaten eggs go straight in when ready.
steps.label: Beat eggs

steps.text: Pour the beaten eggs into the pan with the cooked masala base and mix them in on a very slow flame, keeping scraping the sides so the eggs mix evenly.
steps.label: Add eggs

steps.text: Increase the flame a little if desired and keep stirring until the egg is completely well done, adjusting for how moist or dry you want the bhurji.
steps.label: Finish eggs

steps.text: Turn off the flame and add fresh coriander leaves; mix and serve.
steps.label: Garnish & serve

notes: Method grounded in video transcript and description; timing for masalas ("5 to 7 Minutes") quoted verbatim and used as stated duration. Ingredient prep notes inferred from ingredient lines (e.g., onions chopped) as allowed. 'keep scraping the sides' used as attention cue for periodic stirring.

source_text:
Title: Egg Bhurji Recipe | How To Make Anda Bhurji | The Bombay Chef - Varun Inamdar

Channel: Get Curried

Video description:

Learn how to make Egg Bhurji at home with chef Varun Inamdar only on Get Curried

Egg Bhurji is a dish popular in the north and western India and Pakistan. It is often confused with scrambled eggs and the Parsi dish akuri but Egg Bhurji is a different dish in totality.So watch and learn how to make Egg Bhurji at home with chef Varun Inamdar only on Get Curried.

Ingredients
3 large onions
3 large tomatoes
4 green chillies
1 inch piece Ginger
2 tbsp butter
2 tbsp vegetable oil
Salt as required
1 tbsp red chilly powder
1/2 tbsp turmeric powder
1 tbsp pav bhaji masala
Handful of coriander leaves
6 large eggs

Method
- Chop onions finely
- Add oil, butter and onions and allow the onions to sweat
- Chop chillies and ginger and add it to the pan
- chop tomatoes and add into the pan 
- Add salt, turmeric, red chilli powder and pav bhaji masala
- Mix everything
- Beat the eggs add salt and put the eggs into the pan
- Egg Bhurji is ready to be served.

Egg bhurji is a scrambled eggs dish originating from the Indian subcontinent. It is sometimes compared with the Parsi dish akuri. The difference lies in its preparation and addition of sautéed chopped onions, chilies and optional spices.It is usually served with rotis or naan or pav/bread in Mumbai. .
